title: Computer Software Assurance for Production and Quality Management System Software
notes: FDA frames computer software assurance as a risk-based way to establish confidence in automation used for production or quality management systems.
The guidance focuses rigor where software could affect device quality, production, or quality management outcomes.
CSA supplements FDA software validation guidance and supersedes the older automated process equipment and quality system software section for this scope.

title: General Principles of Software Validation
notes: FDA emphasizes documented intended use, user requirements, validation protocol, acceptance criteria, testing evidence, and validation summary.
The regulated manufacturer remains responsible for showing the software performs as intended in the chosen application.
Testing should challenge functions and conditions relevant to the intended use, including critical parameters and error conditions.

title: EudraLex Volume 4 Annex 11: Computerised Systems
status: Current published annex, revision consultation closed in 2025
notes: EU GMP Annex 11 is the main EU GMP anchor for computerised systems used in regulated pharmaceutical operations.
The annex is commonly read together with Chapter 4 documentation expectations and the broader EudraLex Volume 4 GMP framework.
Key themes include validation, supplier/service provider management, data integrity controls, security, audit trails, backup, and change control.

title: ICH Q9(R1): Quality Risk Management
notes: ICH Q9(R1) supports structured quality risk management and risk-based decision-making across pharmaceutical quality systems.
The revision highlights formality in QRM, subjectivity management, product availability risks, and risk-based decision-making.
For CSV and GxP systems, Q9(R1) helps justify proportional controls based on risk to patient safety, product quality, and data integrity.

title: ICH Q10: Pharmaceutical Quality System
notes: ICH Q10 describes a pharmaceutical quality system model spanning development, technology transfer, commercial manufacturing, and product discontinuation.
The model complements GMP and supports lifecycle management, management responsibility, corrective and preventive action, and continual improvement.
For SAP-enabled processes, Q10 supports tying system controls to the broader quality system rather than treating validation as a one-off document exercise.

title: Good Practices for Computerised Systems in Regulated GxP Environments (PI 011)
notes: PIC/S identifies PI 011 as computerised systems guidance for regulated GxP environments and notes that it is under revision.
The guidance is useful for inspection-oriented thinking around validation, lifecycle controls, electronic records, electronic signatures, security, backup, and regulated-user responsibilities.
Because PI 011 is under revision, the app should surface it as inspectorate guidance to consider alongside current local law and GMP requirements.

title: WHO GMP for Pharmaceutical Products: Main Principles
notes: WHO describes GMP as quality assurance that products are consistently produced and controlled to quality standards appropriate to intended use.
WHO GMP main principles provide a broad baseline for manufacturing authorization, inspection, training, production, quality control, and quality assurance.
For computerized SAP processes, WHO GMP supports the need for defined, validated, reviewed, and documented processes.

title: WHO GMP: Guidelines on Validation
notes: WHO validation guidance is useful for explaining qualification and validation as lifecycle activities within GMP.
The guidance supports a documented, risk-aware approach to validation activities rather than treating validation as a single test event.
For SAP programs, it helps position CSV evidence as part of broader validation planning and lifecycle maintenance.

title.en: Guidance for On-Site Inspection of Independent Software Appended in Good Manufacturing Practice for Medical Devices
title.zh: 医疗器械生产质量管理规范独立软件现场检查指导原则

status.en: Issued guidance notice; English page available from NMPA
status.zh: 国家药监局综合司通知，药监综械管〔2020〕57号

urlNotes.en: English NMPA page is official. Chinese link is a China Food and Drug News mirror citing the NMPA website because the direct Chinese NMPA page was not reliably retrievable during cache refresh.
urlNotes.zh: 英文链接为国家药监局英文官网。中文链接为中国食品药品网转载并注明来源于国家药监局网站；本次更新未能稳定取得国家药监局中文官网直链。

en: NMPA issued inspection guidance to support supervision of medical device manufacturers implementing GMP and independent software requirements.
The notice is especially relevant when explaining China medical device software inspection expectations and local regulatory supervision.
For SAP or quality system software in China-related projects, use this source as a China regulator signal and verify detailed Chinese-language requirements before final compliance positions.
zh: 国家药监局综合司印发该指导原则，用于加强医疗器械生产企业实施《医疗器械生产质量管理规范》及其附录独立软件的监督检查。
该指导原则面向监管部门开展现场检查和检查结果评估，适合用于解释中国医疗器械独立软件相关的本地检查关注点。
涉及中国项目中的 SAP 或质量体系软件时，应优先参考中文监管口径，并在形成正式合规结论前核对现行中文法规和检查要求。

title: GAMP 5 Guide, 2nd Edition
notes: ISPE positions GAMP 5 as practical industry guidance for effective, high-quality, fit-for-intended-use GxP computerized systems.
The second edition emphasizes critical thinking, supplier involvement, iterative and incremental methods, software tools, automation, cloud, AI/ML, open-source software, and data integrity links.
Because this is industry guidance rather than a regulation, the app should use it to explain implementation approaches while tying compliance claims back to applicable regulator requirements.
